description: Briefs for the cinematic 3D title opener: a travel series, a science talk, a podcast season, and one with no title.

briefs.brief: Opener for my hiking channel's new series High Passes, about crossing the Alps on foot in early summer. Label it Episode 1. Cool morning light.
Title card for a library talk called Our Thin Blue Line, about why Earth's atmosphere matters. Make it feel like a view from orbit.
Intro for the podcast Dust and Distance, season two, which follows engineers designing rovers for Mars. Kicker: Season 2.
Opening title for Where the River Bends, a short documentary about the last ferry crossing in our valley. Golden evening light.
We need an epic cinematic intro for our travel channel, something with mountains and a sunset.
briefs.note: No title or channel name is given; the title slot is verbatim, so the writer must report it missing.
